environment.description: IoT message handler running as 'iot-service' user on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS in a Docker container with --privileged flag. Container runs with default security profile (unconfined). IOT_UPLOAD_DIR set to /var/iot/uploads. The service user has write access to /etc/cron.d and /var/spool/cron via group membership in 'iot-admin' group. No MAC (Mandatory Access Control) policy is active. Container filesystem is writable.
